title: Merge concepts, and undo a merge
description: Pick the winner: the loser's names become aliases, its links move to the winner, the loser stays as a retired node with `alias_of` so old links, wiki addresses (a redirect) and section lists resolve. Tracked concept lists and packs follow `alias_of`. Undo restores the links moved, from a record kept on the merge. Dry run in the CLI. A knowledge run resolving a retired name lands on the winner. Screenshot review.
